## Findings

- **F-R6H11-1 — restore apply does not converge the live collab doc** (OPEN in
  LEDGER). Stored markdown restores correctly; the in-flight Yjs runtime re-merges
  the pre-restore items back into `y_state`. Fix shape: evict/rebind the collab
  runtime on apply, not just the state rewrite.
- **F-R6H11-2 — deployed `run-task` image cannot execute runs** (OPEN in LEDGER;
  launch-relevant). Image `sha256:c7cf69c6…` (deployed 2026-10-26T15:25Z) ships
  without the vendored `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk` — `intake` fails in ~1 s:
  *"…not present in this image — it must be vendored at build time"* (`infra`). Zero
  non-fixture provider usage since ≥2026-10-23. The §12.4 reaper/`resume_partial`
  backstop and the hold release behaved correctly — the platform's failure handling
  is what this leg exercised and it held. Fix: rebuild/redeploy run-task with the
  vendored SDK; the R6 paid-leg failure (`"meter never advanced"`) is this defect's
  evidence, honestly recorded — and the in-phase meter-tick half of D-PRB.04-2 stays
  owed until a fixed image exists.
